nodes.label: Neon Checklist Icon
nodes.rationale: Checked task rows signal task completion as the core interaction.

nodes.label: Neon Glow Dark Visual Style
nodes.rationale: Cyan-to-violet neon glow on black with blocky display type for a bold, techy look.

nodes.label: Friendly Empty State Card
nodes.rationale: 'Nog geen lijsten. Voeg je eerste lijst toe!' with emoji encourages first action instead of a blank screen.

nodes.label: User Registration / Logout Flow
nodes.rationale: Registration success message and prominent red logout button imply account-based app.

nodes.label: Task Sorting Controls
nodes.rationale: Text-link sorting by title or priority, ascending/descending, with arrow indicators.

nodes.label: Task Completion Checkbox
nodes.rationale: Checkbox per task row to mark items done.

nodes.label: Task Priority Levels
nodes.rationale: Low/medium/high priority set on creation and shown inline in task labels.

nodes.label: Task File Upload
nodes.rationale: Attach files/images (e.g. product photo) to a task.

nodes.label: Task Comments
nodes.rationale: Free-text notes attached to a task.

nodes.label: Consistent Card-Based UI System
nodes.rationale: Shared visual language across screens: centered column, light gray background, white rounded cards, blue primary buttons, gray back buttons, red destructive/logout, green success flash messages.

nodes.label: To-Do App Project
nodes.rationale: Dutch-language web to-do app with user auth, multiple lists, prioritized tasks, sorting, comments and file uploads; shown in a design student's portfolio.

nodes.label: Intersecting Roads App Icon (navy + yellow)
nodes.rationale: Navy rounded-square icon with crossing curved roads and yellow dashed center lines; navy/yellow palette evokes road signage.

nodes.label: RoadMate Lowercase Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Rounded sans-serif lowercase with trailing period for an approachable, confident tone.

nodes.label: Road Band Brand Motif
nodes.rationale: Yellow wavy band with dashed center line visually represents a road; logo mark resembles crossing roads. Palette: yellow (#F0C40F-ish), navy, light grey-blue background, rounded sans-serif (Poppins-like).

nodes.label: Play/Stop with Frequency Slider
nodes.rationale: Bottom floating control: green play and red stop buttons flank a 'Frequentie in minuten' slider; lets users set how often RoadMate triggers updates/questions.

nodes.label: Interactive Map with POI Markers
nodes.rationale: OpenStreetMap/Leaflet-style map with zoom controls, 'Voer bestemming in...' search, dense blue pins, and current-location accuracy circle.

nodes.label: Render Hosting Deployment
nodes.rationale: URL bar shows roadmate-q5e8.onrender.com, indicating the app is deployed on Render as a mobile web app.

nodes.label: Active Session / Stop RoadMate Screen
nodes.rationale: Large pulsing yellow circle with status 'RoadMate is actief' and a big red 'Stop RoadMate' button; interval (min) slider at bottom. Large touch target suits use in a car.

nodes.label: Ride Quiz Prompt Screen
nodes.rationale: Card with quiz illustration and Dutch text announcing a quiz about the user's ride; primary 'Start' and secondary 'Een andere keer' pill buttons in brand yellow. Navy header with logo and profile icon.

nodes.label: Welcome Splash Screen (mobile)
nodes.rationale: 'Welcome to' heading, yellow wavy road band with roadmate logo and a small red car illustration, tap-to-continue call to action.

nodes.label: RoadMate Project
nodes.rationale: Dutch-language driving companion web app: users enter a destination on a map, start a session with an interval, and get a quiz about their ride. Brand: yellow road band with dashed lane line, dark navy wordmark.

nodes.label: Design x Development (personal positioning)
nodes.rationale: Portfolio positions the designer at the intersection of design and technology; attention to detail and good UX are claimed to make the difference.

nodes.label: Handwritten Notes & SVG Scribble Annotations
nodes.rationale: Sketchbook-style visual language: animated SVG scribbles (underline, circle, arrow, steam, check) and hand-notes shown only on large screens to give a personal, hand-made feel.

nodes.label: Post-ride Interactive Quiz
nodes.rationale: Quiz as learning component reinforces traffic education after each ride.

nodes.label: RoadMate (voice-controlled traffic sign app)
nodes.rationale: Voice interaction instead of a screen full of text so drivers learn traffic signs without taking their eyes off the road.

nodes.label: Voice Interaction (spraak als veilige interactie)
nodes.rationale: Speech chosen as the safe interaction mode while driving, avoiding distraction.

nodes.label: 3D Ramen Kiosk
nodes.rationale: Inspired by a one-month dream trip to Japan; communicates through renders and video instead of a live site or prototype.

nodes.label: Japanese Culture Inspiration (neon, wood, traditional accents)
nodes.norm_label: japanese culture inspiration (neon, wood, traditional accents)
nodes.rationale: Neon lighting evokes Japanese night streets; wooden textures give a warm craft feel; traditional accents in shape and detail.
